## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Loaded data

```{r}
stroke_data <- read.csv("data/healthcare.csv")
```

4 Visualizations

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = stroke_data, aes(x = stroke, fill = factor(hypertension))) +
  geom_bar(position = 'dodge')　+
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = stroke_data, aes(x = factor(stroke), fill = factor(stroke), y = avg_glucose_level)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = stroke_data, aes(x = heart_disease, fill = factor(gender))) +
  geom_bar(position = 'dodge')　+
  theme_bw()
```

P(A) : Probability of Heartdisease

```{r}
probability_of_heart_disease <- stroke_data |> 
  count(heart_disease) |> 
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n)) |> 
  filter(heart_disease == 1) |> 
  pull(percent)

# 0.054
```

P(B) : Probability of stroke

```{r}
probability_of_stroke <- stroke_data %>% 
  count(stroke) %>% 
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n)) %>% 
  filter(stroke == 1) %>% 
  pull(percent)

# 0.048
```

P(A\|B)

```{r}
probability_of_positive_result_given_stroke <- stroke_data |> 
  count(stroke, heart_disease) |> 
  group_by(stroke) |> 
  mutate(percent = n /sum(n)) |> 
  filter(stroke == 1, heart_disease == 1) |> 
  pull(percent)
```

P(B\|A)

```{r}
(probability_of_positive_result_given_stroke * probability_of_stroke) / probability_of_heart_disease
```

```{r}
data |>  
  ggplot(aes(x = stroke, fill = factor(heart_disease))) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Stroke Count by Heart Disease",
    x = "stoke", y = "Number of Patients", fill = "Heart Disease"
  )
```
